The pencils are specifically designed for early writers, and they feature a number of helpful features to support proper grip and control. The thick 1.3mm lead is less prone to breaking, which is great for little hands that may not yet have a lot of dexterity. The triangular shape of the pencils helps to guide finger placement, which can be especially beneficial for kids who are still learning how to write. The set includes five pencils in fun barrel colors, as well as a lead refill set and two eraser refills, which makes it a great value. Overall, I highly recommend these triangle pencils to anyone looking for a high-quality writing instrument that is designed with kids in mind.

t: Nice Pencil for my Kids - Why Does it Have to be Disposable
x:
My kids - US 2nd and 6th grades (typically 7-8 and 11-12 years old) - love to use these pencils. They are the target audience for these pencils so I would say this is a success for the manufacturer.

As Paper Mate / Newell Brands knows, the eraser is the first thing to wear out on a pencil (they have been making them for a looooong time). And yet, Paper Mate / Newell Brands has chosen not to sell replacement erasers for these oddly shaped pencils (the shape is good - but not normal). That also means that your general purpose replacement eraser for the pencil's dull end is not compatible with this pencil.

To use these pencils solely for two grade schoolers, I estimated I would need a new 5-pack of pencils for every two weeks of school (due to eraser use). Assuming a 46 week school year and that pencils never get lost or misplaced (lol), I would need to purchase 23 5-packs of pencils. When the year is over, we would have thrown away 115 plastic pencil shells, most of the extra pencil lead and the 25 plastic cases the lead came in. All of this instead of using only a handful of pencils (assuming they break after a bit of use) and cases from pencil lead that was purchased as needed.

Thus, I cannot recommend these wonderful pencils because they are designed for a one way trip to the trash can so that you can purchase more of them. If replacement erasers were available, this would be a five star pencil.

Note - if you have a child prodigy that enjoys using a white vinyl click-eraser (Staedtler Mars highly recommended - search on 52850BK). then you have no problem. I have not found a kid that will use these before at least high school.

Love using these with my Preschooler. Perfect grip, size, and led is thick enough to not break.

These handwriting pencils are excellent for young students! The thicker sized lead doesn’t break easily and prints thick lines. The size of the pencil makes it easy to hold onto. Would definitely recommend!

I'm starting to teach my 3 years old to write and the way she holds her pencils are not correct no matter how many times I corrected it.  So I ordered these triangular pencils.  They really do helps my 3 years old holds her pencils properly.  The price is very good. The lead is very thick at 1.3 mm, so for 3 years old it won't break easily. Very colorful! I am very satisfied! Maybe it will be harder to find the leads, but Amazon is very convenient, I'm sure that I can order them easily at Amazon.  Highly recommended!!!

We homeschool and go through lots of pencil lead. These are a favorite for my early elementary kids. They write easily and the lead is thick, so it doesn't really break. Pencil erasers work well. After a year of *hard* use, some of the pencils started to have mechanical issues and wouldn't always cooperate, but I'm thrilled they lasted that long. For reference, my kids using them were 6, 5, & 4 last year. We ordered them again this year.

I can't use 0.5-0.9 mm lead - it just breaks too easily. I also hold writing implements wrong (according to the nuns) by resting the pen or pencil just above the top knuckle of my middle finger, which leaves a callous. Not with these. They are wide enough that they don't dig into my finger.
Sturdy and bright colors. The lead size is the best part! It is durable and doesn’t break easily like the thinner lead sizes.
I love the look of these pencils and bought them for my students. Unfortunately, a number of them stopped working after the first use and had to be thrown away. Not sure why.

t: The just Write lead pencil for Me!
x: These are by far the best lead pencils I have ever used. As a teacher I purchased to use in my classroom with students, but decided to try them out myself first. The lead is extra thick and doesn’t break like the typical lead pencil when you apply a bit to much force, and at the same time doesn’t add much to the size of the line it produces. These sturdy pencils will be replacing my traditional lead pencils.

These are really nice! They are really easy to hold and the lead did not break once yet. Only thing that can be improved is increasing capacity to allow more than 2 leads to be put into the pencil at once, but the leads last a while, so it isn't a big problem.

I have slight tremors & it’s very difficult to use mechanical pencils w/out breaking the lead constantly. I have to press down harder than normal when I write to make sure it’s legible bc of the tremors. I’ve never seen a mechanical pencil higher than 0.9 so when I saw these were heavier I bought them & they’re perfect for me. I know they’re supposed to be geared more towards younger children but if you know someone who has sensory issues (which I do, so that’s another reason I love them) or someone who is getting older or someone who has arthritis & so many other reasons you might want to stop & think about it  or @ least don’t rule them out.
These are the best! They are durable and the lead doesn’t snap easily! I’ve given them as birthday gifts to students for years and they hold up with my second graders!

Excellent pencil for kindergarteners . This is the pencil I would buy next to the Ticonderoga fat pencils . Only difference between those and this is that these mechanical pencils are not as dark as the yellow fat pencils . The lead doesn’t  break easily either . Extremely satisfied with the purchase
Use for crossword puzzles. Never break the lead. Love these!
These are great pencils, the triangular shape keeps them from rolling, I have a very heavy hand and constantly break my lead, with these it is no longer a problem! You can't beat the price either!
Little hands tend to grip regular pencils tightly and then the pencils break, these are perfect for little hands.

I work in a freezer and wear heavy leather gloves and use these to fill out paperwork in -16 degree temperatures.

They are much easier to hold than a standard #2 pencil, mechanical or otherwise.

If you drop them to the floor from any height the lead doesn’t break inside the pencil like all the others did.

These are the best pencils I've found for my construction crews. They often have to write on various surfaces, and they prefer these bigger pencils because the lead is so thick- it doesn't break easily.

I LOVE, LOVE, LOVE these pencils!!! I’m a teacher & use these pencils when I’m writing notes and recording grades. They are the only ones I use so I actually panic when I can’t find them in stores! Thank goodness for Amazon!! These pencils feel great in my hand and the lead is thick,  strong, and never breaks. (like other mechanical pencils always do). They also seem to make my writing look much neater! Even my middle school students like using them. I hope they never stop making these!!
Reordered these. They’re my absolute favorite pencil. The leads are thick and don’t break easy.

I keep buying products on Amazon, hoping they'll help my 5-yr-old hold her pencil correctly.  Unfortunately, these didn't work. Writing with a regular pencil or a regular paper mate mechanical pencil would make my hand cramp up so bad, and would hurt to write. With the thick mechanical pencil I can write longer and with the thick lead, it’s not snapped once!

t: Nice thick leads! Durable for heavy-handed writers of any age.
x:
I wish I could find packs of eraser refills, and the erasers could be higher quality, but I've been using these as my primary writing instrument for years. I tend to have a death grip on my pencil, and normal mechanical pencil leads will break constantly and even tear through thin paper. These are a perfect thickness, close to twice as thick as any normal mechanical pencils. They make nice bold lines, but not so thick they are unusable for normal writing.

If you want even thicker leads than these, you need to go with drafting type "lead holders" (2mm and up). But those are fussier to use for everyday writing, with no erasers.

The plastic body of the pencils isn't exceptionally durable, like if you step on it or smash it, but they are a sturdier than your average mechanical pencil in this price range.

bought these for my first grader to hopefully help with penmanship and I love them for myself.  The lead is thicker so it does not break easily and the erasers are not tiny.  My oldest has been hoarding them for her personal use as well.

These pencils are great in terms of comfort and visibility. They write with a thick and dark line on paper. The lead (in my experience) has never randomly snapped on me! The erasers on them however leave the paper slightly tinted whatever color the eraser is that you’re using. Doesn’t erase well either. I would recommend using a different eraser.

t: Best pencils ever. Better than Ticonderoga.

Easy to hold, good to write with. The lead is thick enough it doesn't break easy if you push down hard while writing.
Easy to hold, lead doesn't break easily,  writes like a number 2 pencil

Love these thicker pencils. Lead doesn’t break as much as the thinner mechanical pencils.

The grip has been wonderful for my daughter with some fine motor delays however she broke the lead constantly and ruined the erasers quickly. Overall these may be better for someone with better fine motor control

t: Nice thick lead and easy to hold.

These have to be hands down the best pencils for people who like bold or fat writing ink. They provide great grip and comfort with the triangle design. I personally think they don’t break as much when writing like a regular mechanical pencil.

t: 4th Grade Students all time pencil of the year.

The only down fall is 4th grade have to erase a lot and the eraser on the pencil goes fast.  It would be nice if they would sell a big pack of replacement erasers for a reasonable price.  The pencil itself is strong.

On class requests from my students was that I get more to give away as rewards. They lo e these pencils!

We love these pencils, so much that we ordered 6 packs of them!  My 10yo prefers mechanical pencils but we hated how often typical mechanical pencils broke.  The first time we wrote with these we loved them but couldn’t figure out why.  Then we realized the lead is a lot thicker and doesn’t break very often.  The pencils are also thicker and make it easier for kids to hold comfortably.  I am a big fan and wish they were more easily available!

My three and five year old use these pencils daily to help with writing and the grip properly and write with perfect pressure. The lead is thick and does not break easily for the constant crushing of development toddlers. I would DEFINITELY recommend this pencil for growing little writers.

Comfortable and easy to hold, leads don't break off while using! best mechanical pencil Iv'e ever used!

The triangular shape makes them comfortable to hold and prevents rolling. The one negative is that the erasers seem to come out and get lost easily, which can also cause the extra leads to spill out. It is also hard to find replacement erasers. I was pleased with the price of this pack, but I did purchase while the price was discounted a bit.
For something intended for young writers, you would think these would be more durable. I bought these a month ago and they are all already broken.

t: Great garden marker -- thick leads, bright colors
x: The thick leads don't break on me the way standard mechanical pencils do, and they leave a very legible line. They also work on vinyl window blind slats (for markers). If a plant survives its first year, it gets a permanent marker. :-) Bright colors don't get lost easily, even in the garden!

My son is almost OCD about his traditional pencils being sharp. Yet he uses too much pressure for most thin mechanical pencils. These are perfect for him. Lead doesn’t break easily. Comfortable to hold for long writing sessions. love the lead and eraser refills.
My favorite pencil !  Strong lead - does not break easily

A total blessing to get some schoolwork done without the grumbling grumpy gremlins.
I need to order more of these! The lead does not break and they are perfect for little hands and pencil grip. Erasers erase great! No complaints.
